rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact object in all views, with one dominant mass and no visible view-to-view collisions, so repair integrity is strong. However, the mass is still mostly a sealed block with only a shallow top chamfer and little usable public void, court, undercut, or terrace logic at the verified access edge. For the neighborhood_living brief, that is the main weakness: the visible form does not yet establish an active ground threshold or a legible public space figure, and the section remains generic rather than programally expressive. The silhouette is acceptable as an early massing start, but it is not yet doing enough sectional or frontage work to support the semantic invariants. The hard program-fit gate therefore fails, mainly because the ground/public relationship is too weak, not because the object is incoherent.
